metadata.name: quickdraw
metadata.description: Tap trading on Solana: tap the box the price will hit.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The player's owner; the PDA seeds tie the account to this signer.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Circle's devnet USDC: the only token the house takes.

accounts.name: oracle
docs: is owned by the delegation program here; `record_tick` verifies owner and data on the ER.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The player's owner or their active session key.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The player's owner or their active session key; pays nothing (rollup transactions are free).

accounts.name: ledger
docs: Live copy of the base-layer ledger: which earlier stakes have been collected.

accounts.name: user_tokens
docs: Live copy of the player's USDC token account on Solana.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Whoever cranks settlement (the keeper or the player's own app).

types.name: Book
docs: The house: one shared liquidity pool that takes the other side of every tap.
Lives on the ER so taps and settlements touch it in milliseconds.

fields.name: mint
docs: USDC mint players deposit (6 decimals).

fields.name: liquidity
docs: Pool value in mint units, including stakes of open taps.

fields.name: exposure
docs: Sum of the payouts the pool owes if every open tap wins.

fields.name: edge_bps
docs: House edge taken from the fair multiplier, in basis points.

fields.name: max_exposure_bps
docs: Most of the pool that open payouts may claim, in basis points.

fields.name: max_profit
docs: Largest profit a single tap may win, in mint units.

types.name: BookParams
docs: Risk settings of the house.

types.name: Candles
docs: Ring buffer of per-second price ranges, written on the ER by `record_tick`.
Slot `sec % CANDLE_SLOTS` holds the high and low the oracle published during `sec`.

fields.name: market
docs: Market key as raw bytes: `Pubkey` is not `Pod` in this dependency set.

types.name: Ledger
docs: Wallet play: the base-layer record of which wallet-tap stakes the house has collected from the
player's own token account, and how much it has paid back. Never delegated, so the ER reads a
live copy of it: a winning wallet tap only pays once its stake shows up here as collected.

fields.name: collected
docs: Ids (with `WALLET_TAP_FLAG`) of the most recent collected stakes, oldest overwritten first.

types.name: Market
docs: One tradable asset (SOL/USD, BTC/USD, ...), keyed by its oracle price account.
The grid is fixed per market: rows are `band`-wide price bands, columns are `col_secs` long.

fields.name: symbol
docs: Ticker shown in the app, e.g. `SOL`, zero padded.

fields.name: band
docs: Height of one row, in oracle price units (1e-8 USD).

fields.name: col_secs
docs: Length of one column in seconds.

fields.name: sigma_floor
docs: Lowest per-second volatility used for odds, in price units per sqrt(second).

types.name: MarketParams
docs: Grid shape and volatility floor for a market.

types.name: Player
docs: A player's in-game wallet, LP position, session key and open taps. Delegated to the ER while
playing; deposits and withdrawals happen on the base layer.

fields.name: session
docs: Browser-held key allowed to tap without wallet popups until `session_expires`.

fields.name: balance
docs: Free balance in mint units.

fields.name: shares
docs: LP shares of the book.

fields.name: pnl
docs: Realised profit and loss from taps, in mint units.

types.name: TapPlaced
docs: A tap was placed. `price` and `sigma` are the inputs the on-chain odds were computed from.

types.name: TapSettled
docs: A tap was settled. `low`/`high` are the price range recorded during the window: the evidence
anyone can re-check against the candle ring.

fields.name: outcome
docs: 1 = win, 2 = lose, 3 = void (refunded).

types.name: TapSlot
docs: One open position: a stake on the price touching `[lo, hi]` during `[start, end)`.

fields.name: id
docs: Monotonic per-player id so the app can match settlements to taps.
